title: Explicit transfer of resolution section short complexes
statement: Let g:Y→X be a scheme morphism, U,V opens of X, K a nonnegative cochain complex of abelian étale sheaves on X and L one on Y. Let α:K→g_*L be a cochain map [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. For an étale object A over X, an étale object B over Y, and k:B→A×_X Y, define the section chain map in degree n as α^n(A) followed by L^n(k). Define k_X:Y→X×_X Y by (g,id), and k_W:g⁻¹W→W×_X Y by (g|_W,ι). Naturality of α and k makes these transfers commute with restriction. Define resolutionSectionShortComplexTransfer g U V K L α between the explicit section short complexes [def-weil-pbc-etale-mayer-vietoris-section-complex] by the global transfer, the biproduct of the transfers on U and V, and the transfer on U∩V. The two squares commute by restriction naturality and additivity. No covering assumption is needed. All data are explicit constructions.

proof.text: Define the degreewise transfer by evaluating α and restricting along k. The chain-map equation follows from the chain-map equation of α and naturality of the differentials of L. For a commuting site square, naturality of α and functoriality of restriction give commuting transfer maps.

Construct the global and open site maps by the universal property of fibre products. Check their squares with restriction by the two fibre-product projections; for inclusions of opens cancel the monomorphism of the larger open. Build the middle map as biprod.map. Project the first square and inject into the second; the restriction equalities and their negatives give both short-complex morphism equations.
